design.within_each_model: Generate once per requirement; preserve exact output as Single-shot and refine exact same bytes in NLTL. No shared candidate across different models.
design.overlap: Exactly the declared ten IDs and same independent cases/denominators across models; freeze data/scopes before dispatch.
design.source_prompts: Current frozen generator/reviewer/repair; NO B coverage addition or comparison-only coverage schema.
design.selection: Latest technically qualifying candidate under existing delivery policy; approval separate; no external-score selection.
design.unstarted: NOT_RUN retained in denominators/accounting; no automatic substitution or requirement-specific fixing.
design.evaluation: Independent only after dispatch closure for each model run; no fixtures/labels/solutions in production.

limits.time_stopping: Existing reserve policy: do not start another requirement without sufficient remaining allocation (currently 540-second start reserve); unstarted requirements NOT_RUN. Proposed aggregate ceilings are conservative limits, not a runtime forecast.

blockers.details: Retained document hashes verify, but direct whitespace-normalized represented-text/excerpt alignment failed. This does not prove source absence; equations/paraphrase/multiple clauses need exact provenance verification before launch. Queue not resampled to evade blockers.

Existing independent oracle/reference controls and scope binding route cover the bundled regression set, not the additional fifteen. Cases and independent source-backed oracle/construction review are required; no answer-bearing controls enter production.
